name: 56474 · Pine River, MN
findings: ZIP 56474 (Pine River) has 16 nonprofit organizations. 8 of them (50%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 6 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (17% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 56474 (Pine River) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
25% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 56474 (Pine River) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.4 times the typical level).
